$L_{f}=$ length of fragment exposed to the blast (in)
Equation 2-66 is adequate for determining the fragment velocity when:
When Equation 2-67 is less than 0.602, the magnitude of the velocity is equal to zero which indicates that disengagement of the fragment will not occur.
The constants in Equation 2-66 were derived from experimental data and can only be used for cantilevered beams of steel or aluminum.
An equation similar to that of Equation 2-66 has been developed for clamped-clamped fragments except that the value of $C_{1}$ is equal to -0.6498 and $C_{2}$ is equal to 0.4358.
